book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Luke wana Leleli

content: Ebo Nige Wala Gegi ana En Ta Pepek, Nasi Ta Yaomal Hot

Saugena o gamagalau enuna iyoho to heliya Yeisu wana wasa hi pek Galili kaiweliya, bolo Pilato i ba tolohaveyan hi tagapaaligal sauga heliya iyoho hi powopowon, yaka heliya saliyaliya ge wali powon bwasumona saliyana hi vikuhu pamaisena.
Analiya Yeisu i lahe i ba, “Age kaiwena nak o i gan elal, inoke ku nuwatu wali gegi wali pan Galili gegewel wali gegi i bwata lake?
He nigeya! Ge na ba eliyamiu, ebo nige wami gegi ana en nuku pepek, komiu al gegewemiu nuku yaomal.

Ga i ola bolo ali gewi eitin valila limi mihahaina Sailowama elana i maguli i tala pwataliyaa ge hi aliga? Ku nuwatu heliya wali gegi gamagalau gegewel al bolo hi miminaa Yelusalema wali gegi i bwata lake?
He nigeya! Ge na ba eliyamiu, ebo nige wami gegi ana en nuku pepek, komiu al gegewemiu nuku yaomal.”
Inoke Yeisu ba gohalibe ya i baunanik elal i ba, “Poga etega i siuna tau etega wana eyowaa, inoke i nok enona ni loyaan lamwanaa, yaa nige etega i pwapwawa.

Yaka i baek eyowa ana tomatahikan elana i ba, ‘U kite! Iyaka baliman etonina te ya nemnem e, poga ya enona ya loloyaan lamwanaa, yaa nige etega ya pwapwawa. U gove yoho! Ga i ola ge bilibili aana i apapanak-an bwabwage?’
“Anana tomatahikan i lahe i ba, ‘Tonowak, ni minaa baliman maisena al ga, inoke puna ana bilibili na ken paipainan ge bilibili aana ona na telek.
Binimala ebo baliman i nenem ni enon, he i waisi hot. Yaa ebo nigeya, yaka abwe ta gove yoho.’”
Sabwataa Yeisu Yova Eputetena Kokomwina I Pwamolu
Lan Sabwata etega Yeisu i na limi tapwalolo etega elana ge i panpankiti gamagalau elal.
He yova etega iyoho to yayaluwa bibikena etega i holaviya elana ge i pakasiyebwa baliman ana gewi eitin. Yova o eputetena i kom ge i kowau, nige bosowaina kekeisi ni pasapu.
Sauga Yeisu i kite, yaka i yogaan i na elana ge i baek elana i ba, “Yova, ya sokaliwa am gila iyaka i mowasi.”
Inoke nimana i teli pwatanaa, yaka sauga o i milil pasapu ge Yehoba i tobatobal-an.

Yaa limi tapwalolo ana tohouwa i huga, kaiwena Yeisu tokasiyebwa i pwamolu lan Sabwata elana. Inoke i baek gamagalau elal i ba, “Lan ana gewi sikis bosowaina te ta tuwalali. Inoke lan bolo o elana te nuku nem ge ni pwamolomiu, lan Sabwata bahiwa.”

Anana Babala i lahe i ba, “Tokakakawi komiu, komiu maisena ge maisena lan Sabwata elana i nana bwasumu wali limiya ge wana bulumakau ge donki i sosokalil, yaka i nunulil tagilagil ge i nana i papaimwil. I ola age?
He yova ya iya Abalahama tubutubunina etega, ge Seitani i yowan baliman ana gewi eitin. Age bahi ana eyowan na sosokal lan Sabwata elana?”
Sauga Yeisu i ba ola o, inoke ana topihigelgel gegewel hi puluwawi. Yaa gamagalau gegewel ginol waiwaisal gegewena bolo Yeisu i ginolil hi yaliyaya-an.
Ebwakil Masted Pwatumwina ana Ba Gohalibe
Inoke Yeisu i ba vevehe al i ba, “Yehoba wana abalogugui i ola hauna bugul? Ge binimala hauna elana na papatini-aniya?
He i ola te ebwakil toto alana masted pwatumwina, tau etega i ahe ge i luwan wana eyowaa. Pwatum o i siun ge i tabwa ebwakil, inoke bwasumu bolo hi youyou hawawala ali vata hi ginola lalana elana.”
Yis ana Ba Gohalibe
Inoke Yeisu i ba al, “Hauna elana ge binimala Yehoba wana abalogugui na papatini-aniya?
He i ola te yis, yova etega i ahe ge i telek pwalawa ana bwaya beig eton gamwanaa, inoke yis i tuwalali ana siga pwalawa gegewena i tuk solaan.”
Nuku Logasisi Nuku Ulutuka Abatuk toto I Kikipu elana
Yeisu i nanawa Yelusalema kaiwena ge i nosola panuwa bwabwatal ge awan kekeisi elal inoke i panpankiti gamagalau elal.
Gamagal etegana i nel elana i ba, “Babala, age gamagalau ehila ya te pwamwal nihi pwawa?” I baek elal i ba,
“Nuku logasisi nuku ulutuka abatuk toto i kikipu elana. Na ba eliyamiu, gamagalau nihi gewi nihi labose nihi tuk, yaa nige bosowailiya.
Sauga ebo tonlimi ni lut nog ni kaus, komiu nuku talmilil tola ge nuku pitipiti nuku ba, ‘Babala, nog u pwela kaiwema.’ Yaka anamiu ni lahe ni ba, ‘Nige ya aatenamiu ga ku neem.’
Inoke nuku baek elana nuku ba, ‘Valila aloma owa ta anan ge ta imwim. Ge u talmilila wama kamwasa elal, yaka u panpankiti eliyama.’
Yaa anamiu ni lahe ni ba, ‘Nige ya aatenamiu ga ku neem. Gegewemiu ku egonan, komiu nak ana toginol!’
Abalahama, Aisake, Yakobo ge palopitau gegewel nuku kitel nihi minaa Yehoba wana abaloguguiya, yaa komiu ni alitagil-agimiu nuku minaa tola, yaka nuku kahikahin ge ninimiu ni alavekilal.
Gamagalau nihi neem sabwelu i heheya ge i lolobeka, labi mala ge nola, inoke nihi misiyo Yehoba wana abalogugui elana ge nihi anan.
Inoke gamagalau enuna bolo sauga ya hi mimula, abwe nihi mihouwa, ge enuna bolo sauga ya hi mihouwa abwe nihi mimula.”
Yeisu Nuwana I Nak Yelusalema ana Tomina kaiweliya
Sauga o elana boda Palisi enuna hi na hi baek Yeisu elana hi ba, “Panuwa ya nu eguluwan ge nu na labi getoga elana, kaiwena Helodi nuwana ni loliwa.”

Analiya Yeisu i lahe i ba, “Nuku na nuku baek to ewalili sisibana o elana nuku ba, ‘Lan ya ge bwaligumwa yayaluwa bibikel na patuna owaowa-agil ge tokasiyebwa na pwamolol, yaka lan etonina elana abwe no tuwalali na pwamowasi.’
He i ola to. Inoke lan ya, bwaligumwa ge bolu na nawanawa al ga, kaiwena nige bosowaina palopita etega nihi lola labi getoga elana, iyai te Yelusalema.

“Eeu geb Yelusalema ana tomina! Komiu palopitau ku lolil ge bolo Yehoba i patunal eliyamiu ku loipatagil. Sauga i gewi nuwau wami gamagalau na bugul papahel, ni ola kamkam meluyovana natunau i bugul papahel opena gabulanaa, yaa nige nuwamiu i oola.

He inoke wami Limi Bwabwalena Yehoba ni galaluwai ge ni enonovan. Na baewa eliyamiu, nige al nuku kikiteyau ana siga na sikalim al, inoke sauga o nuku tobalagau nuku ba, ‘Yehoba ni ba muloluan, iya i nem Babala alana elana!’”
